about_the_game:
The Office Killer is a 1-3 player online co-op survival horror game. As a spy, your main goal is to complete the file transfer process containing the office's secrets while monitoring live surveillance camera footage. Can you survive the entire night or will you get caught by the killer?

You and your team are known as a group of independent spies who know how to crack high-security digital systems. Your identity is kept secret and you are in charge of night operations as a civilian. One day you are contacted by a person codenamed anonymous via email, claiming to have dark secrets about a company. When your team's research and the evidence gathered in the previous years match the information provided by the anonymous person, you decide to infiltrate the office of this company at around 0 o'clock at night. However, no one knows that in this office, a killer who has not been found for years lives and works in a room in the data center isolated from the outside world.

According to the rumors about the office, the building is deserted, with black windows, and creepy noises are heard near the office building at night. Cameras inside the office are monitored by a system installed by the killer and sensors alarm at the slightest movement. The company's data is stored in a private data center isolated from the outside world and can only be accessed from inside the company. Remote infiltration is impossible. So you have to physically enter the data room without getting caught.

The Office Killer

In 1996, he was the prime suspect in a horrific murder that remains unsolved. After the incident, he managed to cover his tracks, living under false identities and withdrawing completely from society. He lives his new life in the office of a company where no one will notice him, working the night shift and living in a data center room isolated from the outside world, which is forbidden to enter except for this person.

On the outside, he looks like an ordinary employee, but on the inside his dark tendencies have never disappeared. During his time in the office corridors, his psychological state has deteriorated and his paranoia and obsessions have increased.

Dealing with this villain will be a bit difficult because he can hear the sounds in every room through his unique camera system, which is also a sensitive audio listener and has many features. He will never give up until he catches you, so don't get caught and if there is noise in the rooms, find a place to hide before he sees you.

Mia's soul

After her tragic death, Mia's soul has found no peace and is filled with rage. The office building is one of the killer's past hideouts, where Mia's energy is somehow trapped. However, Mia's spirit will not help you directly, but will be both a threat and a source of clues with its unstable and different personalities.

Customization

You can change your spy character and adding funny accessories.

1-3 Player CO-OP

Play together with your friends or struggle alone, if you have none.

Proximity Voice Chat

Communicate with your teammates with proximity voice chat.

Replayability

All anomalies, souls, thrilling events and collectable item positions are randomized, ensuring that no two games are the same. What's more, The Office Killer's strong AI ups the game, making you second-guess every move.

Player Progression

Players gain experience depending on what they do during the game, even if they die in each game. With this experience, players can change their character and unlock certain accessories with level.

Are you ready to face The Office Killer?

content_descriptors.notes: This game may contain horror elements and content that is not suitable for all ages. Make sure you are in an appropriate setting.
